### Linked Issues
Closes #(issue number or BXX ID)

### Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user-facing capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `chore`: Build system, dependencies, or configuration update
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline, Jenkinsfile, Docker, or Ansible change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update or addition
- [ ] `test`: Unit, integration, or Selenium test additions

## Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] Source code compiles successfully (`mvn clean compile`).
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass (`mvn test`).
- [ ] Packaged build produces a valid WAR (`mvn package`).
- [ ] Verified branch adheres to Git Flow conventions (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `hotfix/*`).
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated in `docs/` or `README.md`.
- [ ] Evidence captured and archived in `docs/evidence/` if applicable.
